summary: Analyzes and visualizes head-direction cell tuning transformations in symmetric environments by generating synchronized heatmaps across pre-learning, learning, and post-learning epochs.
use_when: How do HD-cell tuning curves change when exposed to a symmetric visual scene?
Generate a centered heatmap of neural tuning curves for spatial orientation.
Assess bimodality in head-direction cell activity during virtual reality learning epochs.
Sort ROI tuning curves by preferred orientation across multiple experimental phases.
Compare pre-learning and post-learning HD-cell responses using normalized color-scaled heatmaps.
avoid_when: Neural and behavioral measurements cannot be aligned on a common time base
The intended conclusion requires causal inference from an observational association alone
